articles.title: China Reveals New Mobility Trick For DF-17 Hypersonic Missile | Watch
articles.description: China has revealed a new exercise involving its DF-17 hypersonic missile system, demonstrating that the launcher can reportedly relocate even after advanced launch preparations have begun. Featured in the documentary Securing Victory, the operation showed a PLA Rocket Force unit travelling to another firing position before successfully launching the weapon. The DF-17 combines a rocket booster with a manoeuvrable hypersonic glide vehicle, producing a less predictable flight path than a conventional ballistic missile. Its estimated range could place Taiwan and military targets across much of the first island chain within reach. The latest footage focuses on survivability rather than speed: if a launcher can abandon a compromised site while the weapon is already prepared, enemy surveillance has less time to locate and destroy it. China is developing the DF-17 as part of a mobile strike network capable of evading detection and attacking from unexpected positions. Watch.
